أصطبن (form VIII)

# أُصْطَبَنُ (ʔuṣṭabanu) /ʔusˤ.tˤa.ba.nu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
# أَصْطَبِنَ (ʔaṣṭabina) /ʔasˤ.tˤa.bi.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
# أُصْطَبَنَ (ʔuṣṭabana) /ʔus
